name: No communication gap
title: Smooth Project Sync (Healthy Conversation)
description: A well-coordinated conversation where team members answer questions directly, share assets, and confirm decisions.
conversation:
Neha: What time is the team sync today?
Ravi: The sync is scheduled for 3 PM in Room B.
Neha: Great, I will have the presentation slides ready.
Soham: I have already uploaded the latest dataset to Drive.
Ravi: Awesome, I reviewed the dataset and everything is approved.

name: Unanswered question
title: Meeting Time Query Ignored (Unanswered Question)
description: Neha asks for the meeting time, but Ravi and Soham proceed to talk about reports and datasets without answering.
conversation:
Neha: What time is the meeting?
Ravi: I am working on the report.
Soham: I'll send the dataset.

name: Repeated request
title: Dataset Follow-up (Repeated Request)
description: Ravi asks for the dataset, receives only an acknowledgment without delivery, and must repeat the exact request.
conversation:
Ravi: Can you send the dataset?
Soham: Okay.
Priya: I am finishing the sprint review slides.
Ravi: Can you send the dataset?

name: Clarification request
title: Ambiguous Architecture Directive (Repeated Clarification)
description: Vague instructions trigger confusion, leading to multiple clarification queries without a clear explanation.
conversation:
Alex: We need to revamp the entire pipeline logic before tonight.
Ravi: What do you mean?
Alex: Just tweak the core modules.
Soham: Can you clarify?
Ravi: Which one?

name: Unresolved topic
title: Q4 Budget Sidetracked (Unresolved Topic)
description: Neha introduces the Q4 budget topic, but teammates deflect to the client demo and the topic is abandoned without resolution.
conversation:
Neha: What about the budget for Q4?
Ravi: Let's focus on the client demo first.
Soham: Yes, the client demo is top priority today.
Neha: The demo looks stable on staging.

expected_gaps.speaker: Neha
expected_gaps.message: What about the budget for Q4?

name: Multiple communication gaps
title: Chaotic Release Coordination (Multiple Gaps)
description: A high-friction exchange exhibiting unanswered questions, repeated resource requests, clarification confusion, and unresolved topics.
conversation:
Neha: What time is the production release?
Ravi: Can someone provide the database credentials?
Soham: What do you mean?
Ravi: Can someone provide the database credentials?
Soham: Which one?
Amit: I noticed an issue with the payment gateway.
Priya: I have to step out for 15 minutes.

expected_gaps.speaker: Neha
expected_gaps.message: What time is the production release?

expected_gaps.speaker: Ravi
expected_gaps.message: Can someone provide the database credentials?

expected_gaps.speaker: Amit
expected_gaps.message: I noticed an issue with the payment gateway.
